result:
If I could change one thing, it would be to make suffering visible and unavoidable.

Not in a cruel way, but so that no one could ever comfortably ignore the pain of another person. So that when someone is hungry, exploited, lonely, or terrified, you would feel a real, immediate pull to care, the way you would for someone you love.

Everything else — poverty, war, disease, injustice — is downstream of people being able to look away from each other. If that distance disappeared, the world would change itself.
